text:
**The evidence does not establish whether the 2021 tree-cover loss was illegal.** It supports approximately 81.3 hectares of loss on the property, of which 68.1 hectares were mapped as planted forest.

Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting and does not by itself establish deforestation, the cause of the change, or whether it was authorized. Determining legality would require relevant permits and other regulatory records.
